generation.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Flat four-square material albedo sheet for the approved T50 fish merchant stall shown in reference. Divide entire square exactly into FOUR equal square swatches, seamless edge-to-edge layout with no dividers, gaps, labels or borders. TOP LEFT: weather-beaten ivory-beige fishing canvas, fine coarse weave, salt-water tide marks, stitched repairs and irregular muted brown stains; light enough to read in dark environment. TOP RIGHT: old dark grey-brown wharf oak timber with fine vertical grain, splinters, water damage and pale rubbed streaks. BOTTOM LEFT: corroded forged iron with restrained rust and salt-blue oxide, mottled pits and scratches; no actual bolts or metal object. BOTTOM RIGHT: brown coarse rope-fibre surface texture, rich strand detail and salt grime, a flat material not a drawn rope or net. All swatches richly layered with intricate physical detail. Fully OPAQUE RGB alpha255 everywhere, no transparency, no corner fading, no vignette, constant even flat lighting. Flat top-down texture surfaces only, no fish, no stall, no 3D objects, flags, signs, emblems, words, framing or cast shadows. Reference is MATERIAL style only. Highest square resolution.
